title: Last Stand C:U
description: Mod that makes totem animation look like last stand from "Casualties: Unknown"
body:
**Last Stand** mod for Minecraft

Disables totem sound and totem pop-up and shows last stand animation to player.
Works only for user of the mod. Other totems will be rendered as usual.
Mod has config that requires **Cloth Config** and **Mod Menu** mods:
- **_You can change background opacity or disable it entirely_**
- **_Change 3 duration settings_**
- **_Enable smooth appear_**
- **_Enable own totem particles_**

_Sounds and animation from "Casualties: Unknown" game by Orsoniks_
